# One template per block; {k} is replaced by each word of words.txt.
=== instring bas
Sub P()
x = "ab{k}cd"
End Sub
=== incomment bas
Sub P()
' note{k}x = 1
End Sub
=== inrem bas
Sub P()
Rem note{k}x = 1
End Sub
=== trailcomment bas
Sub P()
x = 1 ' note{k}
y = 2
End Sub
=== innumber bas
Sub P()
x = 12{k}34
End Sub
=== inhex bas
Sub P()
x = &H1{k}F
End Sub
=== inname bas
Sub P()
xy{k}z = 1
End Sub
=== afterthen bas
Sub P()
If a Then{k}x = 1
End Sub
=== afterelse bas
Sub P()
If a Then x = 1 Else{k}x = 2
End Sub
=== afterlabel bas
Sub P()
L:{k}x = 1
End Sub
=== afterlinenum bas
Sub P()
10{k}x = 1
End Sub
=== aftercolon bas
Sub P()
x = 1:{k}y = 2
End Sub
=== beforeeol bas
Sub P()
x = 1{k}
End Sub
=== beforeendsub bas
Sub P()
x = 1
End Sub{k}
=== subheader bas
Sub P({k}a As Long)
End Sub
=== subheader2 bas
Sub P(a As Long{k})
End Sub
=== dimcomma bas
Dim a As Long,{k}b As Long
=== declstart bas
{k}Dim a As Long
=== dateliteral bas
Sub P()
x = #1/1/{k}2000#
End Sub
=== typesuffix bas
Sub P()
x = a{k}%
End Sub
=== bracketname bas
Sub P()
x = [a{k}b]
End Sub
=== callnl bas
Sub P()
Call{k}f
End Sub
=== attrline bas
Attribute VB_Name{k}= "m"
=== optionline bas
Option{k}Explicit
=== selectcase bas
Sub P()
Select Case a
Case 1,{k}2
End Select
End Sub
=== dotmember bas
Sub P(o As Object)
x = o.{k}p
End Sub
=== dotbefore bas
Sub P(o As Object)
x = o{k}.p
End Sub
